purpose: Controlled, single normal decision on previously exposed, initially difficult camera frames. Does a jointly generated conditional side-view remove the need to ask again after a pre-motion target-association refusal? Actual complete-task times are not identifiable from this assay.
cases: Use every distinct native development layout with a decision-bound, first-camera approach and a witnessed original visual geometry rejection in actual_approach_failures.csv. Salt-rank eligible arms within each layout by camera SHA and relative source; use exactly one ordinary source per layout, without consulting subsequent action, field truth or return time. Keep existing historical original as an explicitly observational reference.
design: One vanilla upstream prompt and one identical prompt with optional on_unresolved on the identical first camera, ordinary user task, initial clock, pose, geometry, and history; no historical action and no feedback in either input. Schedules alternate order by layout. The model can freely choose move, approach, observe, record or submit. One actual attempt per slot with a strict cap and zero retries; seal all model replies and input/byte hashes before any fresh navigation or private geometry scoring. Omit auxiliary view-nomination fields of the previous experimental arms for both. No large-model training.
execution: New independent clean simulator reset per reply. Match the same world/texture fingerprints, measured initial pose and frozen local source region; preserve uncertain or mismatch. Rebind the archived decision to that fresh observation only for this explicitly measured simulation replay. Normal move and approach use the unchanged original tools. Only a refusal for one of four source-association codes, before moving, at the same pose, can activate the alternative in the very same actual reply. Purely lateral/backward or in-place camera moves only (at most 0.15 m component toward unresolved ray), named source, independent observation and current original map admission required. Do not run a second model call or invent fallback coordinates. Every attempted movement and final real photograph is logged, and no assumed completion credit is awarded.
outcome: Primary mechanism witness: the first actual augmented reply included its bound option, the real native resolver rejected before moving for an eligible reason, the alternative was admitted and reached, and the new image independently shows at least 144 pixels of the single source body ID plate plus the pertinent door surface or all shelf components/cartons, at least 1.25x as many pixels of the limiting relevant component as at the initial photo. Require both independent render alignments >=0.90, a unique original plate center inside the archived initiating approach box dilated by zero and >=36 visible plate pixels. Report regular movements, weaker reach-only observations, missing masks and safe abstentions separately. These controlled decisions are not new natural task successes. Only consider integrating with a new natural trial if a witness actually occurs; do not repeat the same dataset to trigger the witness.
